External tools let your AI assistant perform more tasks, such as:

• Search the web
• Read and write local files
• Query databases
• Send emails
• Manage calendars

Each tool is like an 'App' - once installed, your AI can use them when needed.

tour.replayDesc: View the product feature introduction again

step1.content: EvoLoop is your Universal AI Agent, helping you efficiently complete cross-platform orchestration, code writing, and automation tasks. Click the LOGO to expand or collapse the sidebar.
step1.title: Welcome to EvoLoop

step2.content: Engage in natural language conversations with the Universal Agent. Get cross-platform automation, programming help, and code reviews. Supports multi-turn conversations with context awareness.
step2.title: Smart Chat

step3.content: Centralized management for all your code projects. Supports project creation, file browsing, code search, and version control integration.
step3.title: Projects

step4.content: Manage your code knowledge base and learning resources. Store frequently used code snippets, documentation, and best practices for quick reference.
step4.title: Library

step5.content: Configure LLM models, interface themes, language preferences, and other system options. Customize EvoLoop to match your workflow.
step5.title: Settings

step6.content: View and manage all conversation sessions. Quickly switch between different topics or create new chat sessions.
step6.title: Chat Sidebar

step7.content: View your complete conversation history with the AI. Supports code highlighting, file previews, and message quoting.
step7.title: Message Area

step8.content: Manage context information for the current conversation, including relevant files, references, and execution status. Helps the AI better understand your needs.
step8.title: Context Panel

step9.content: Type messages to chat with the AI. Supports file attachments, file references, voice input, and quick commands for more efficient communication.
step9.title: Input Area
